aspect: The airline is fined, so the airline screens
description: Carriers face penalties for bringing inadmissible passengers, so check-in staff apply their own risk assessment - with no obligation to explain and no appeal at the desk.
energy_note: Judged by a check-in agent on commercial risk.

aspect: Denied boarding is not denied entry, and costs the same
description: He has a valid visa and does not travel. There is no refusal on record to appeal, because no immigration officer ever saw him.
energy_note: Turned back before anyone official saw him.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the supervisor is called
description: One-way ticket, cash purchase, a name the system renders two ways. The agent calls a supervisor, who looks at him rather than the screen, then says the flight is closed. It is not closed; boarding continues for twenty minutes.
energy_note: Told it was closed, watching it board.
